title: Next One Piece sets are on Bandai's English page: EB-06 on 29 Jan, OP-19 on 5 Mar 2027
detail: Official English products page lists EB-06 East Blue (29 Jan 2027) and OP-19 Come In, World (5 Mar 2027, pre-release 26 Feb), both $4.99 a pack; also PEB-01 Premium Extra Booster on 23 Apr 2027 ($7.99 a pack). Japan is a day earlier for EB-06 (30 Jan) and OP-19 (27 Feb) per a Samurai Sword Tokyo article citing Bandai's Japanese page, not checked directly. No French dates yet.
source: Bandai One Piece Card Game (official, EN)

title: Today: Pokémon Regional Stuttgart and One Piece Regional Alicante
detail: Both are listed for today. Results are not out yet; Limitless's latest Pokémon result is still Chiba (22 Nov). Next weekend: Las Vegas (Pokémon) and Munich, Utrecht, Peoria, Santiago and Mexico City (One Piece).

title: Aura Seeker (ME7): still no official page found
detail: One source (Nerdsnack) says it was out in Japan on 27 Nov and The Pokémon Company has not announced an English release; others (Wargamer, Zatu) say the Mega Lucario Z set is not official yet. English name Flowing Fists and early 2027 are fan-site reports. Treat date and name as unconfirmed. No prices found yet.

title: Réunion shops: nothing new
detail: Miyata Kard Market: no OP-18 or Aura Seeker product listed; 30e Anniversaire Elite Trainer Box and EV03 boosters sold out, no restock date. Sortilèges' home page shows a generic pre-order section with no products named. No price-mover check today (collection file has no TCGdex ids).
